title: sarkaar ali moula sarkaar ali moula
body:
sarkaar ali moula sarkaaar ali moula
muqtarou ki dunya ke muqtaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyou se maka'n deen ka abaad hai ab tak
aamad se teri kaabe ka dil shaad hai ab tak
hasti hai abhi tak bhi deewaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
parwaaz kisi fikr ki waa'n ja nahi sakti
aqle bashari garde qadam pa nahi sakti
ooncha hai bohat tera mai'yaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
maida'n me ajab tarha ke manzar nazar aaye
pattou ki tarha udhte hue sar nazar aaye
jis waqt chali teri talwaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
hairaano paresha'n hue har baat pe har dam
sunte rahe meraaj me sarkare do aalam
hotou se tere rab ki guftaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
paighambare islam ka ham dard nahi hai
juz aap ke qaibar me koi mard nahi hai
is baat ka sab ko hai iqraar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ko kaha'n chod ke tum jaoge bolo
har jaa'n nazar ayenge zara ankhe to kholo
is paar ali moula us paar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
tu nafse quda waj'he quda aine quda hai
bachpan se madadgaare rasoole dosara hai
sar par hai wilayat hai dastaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
maidaan me manzar ye sabhi dekh rahe the
hathou pe nabi ke hai ali dekh rahe the
dushman ke thi chehrou par phitkaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
qaibar me ajab waqt hai islam ke upar
islam ke lashkar se pareshaa'n hai payambar
kuffar pe ho jaye yalghaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
masnad se nabi ki yahi aati hai sadaye
mimbar yahi kehta hua deta hai duaae
juz tere nahi koi haqdaar ali moula
<<DIVIDER>>
tum chod ke moula ko kaha'n jaoge bolo
moujood wo har jaa'n hai zara aankh to kholo
is paar ali moula us paar ali moula
